people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Now where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you, nor against this land?’
translations.bsb: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, claiming, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or this land’?
translations.kjv: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
translations.asv: Where now are your prophets that prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
